inningMap.expectation: The favorite must turn traffic into runs before the underdog gets a cheap inning.
inningMap.watch: Avoid laying tax into dead contact.

inningMap.expectation: If still close, the favorite edge is mostly market inertia.
inningMap.watch: Look for hedge/live underdog price instead.

inningMap.expectation: Late favorite bailout is not the base case.
inningMap.watch: Do not compound if the bridge is stressed.

marketImplications.side: Do not treat Padres as a plain full-game ML. Price the starter window, bridge, and conversion risk separately.
marketImplications.first5: First-five may be cleaner than full game if the starter-window edge is on the pick and the late edge flips.
marketImplications.total: Under is allowed only if RF/totals backtest agrees with the line bucket.
marketImplications.firstInning: YRFI is the timing lane to compare against the side; modeled chance 84.8% YRFI.

rfLens.trustedUse: Use RF as a nonlinear totals/game-shape check first. Do not let it pick ML/F5 by itself yet.
rfLens.totalsRead: RF totals baseline can be used as a second check on the posted total.
rfLens.moneylineRead: RF moneyline history is not deployable; it can only flag disagreement for review.
rfLens.first5Read: RF first-five history is not deployable; use it as a timing warning, not a pick.
rfLens.firstInningRead: RF first-inning history is not deployable; keep it behind explicit early-run features.
